why: The specs were written with the socket tools on the right arm. Power Suits swapped the arms (2026-10-13) by mirroring the whole model, so bb.mjs mirrors the model back for the specs and mirrors their output onto the live rig.
ankle_why: Legs v10 (final feet, 2026-10-15): the boot hinges at the shin's front bottom edge. Toes down more than ~4 deg sinks the shin's back into the sole; toes up to 40 the shin's back rocks up over the boot's arc-shaped heel (no gap). Past the range plant() rolls the boot (k2.js).
